description: Verifies the Fishbone-Moncrief torus: the enthalpy and density at the pressure maximum and at the cusp, the exclusion of the region inside the inner edge, the normalization of the fluid four-velocity, the polytropic and enthalpy relations and the Cartesian evaluation.

checks.label: the specific angular momentum is positive
the potential at the inner edge exceeds that at the centre
the enthalpy at the pressure maximum equals the maximum enthalpy
the density at the pressure maximum equals the configured maximum
the enthalpy at the cusp equals 1
the region inside the inner edge is empty
the pressure maximum lies inside the torus with positive density and pressure
the fluid four-velocity satisfies u.u = -1 inside the torus
the pressure follows P = K rho^Gamma
the enthalpy follows h = 1 + Gamma / (Gamma - 1) P / rho
the Cartesian evaluation at the pressure maximum returns the peak density and a positive pressure
the Cartesian evaluation inside the cusp returns a negligible density
